event_chain.summary: Customer data put into unauthorized AI app

summary: Community Bank (CB Financial Services), which operates in southwestern Pennsylvania, Ohio and West Virginia, disclosed in an SEC Form 8-K (Item 1.05) that non-public customer information including names, Social Security numbers and dates of birth was handled using an unauthorized AI-based software application. The bank became aware of the internal incident on May 5, 2026, secured the information, engaged external cybersecurity advisors and determined on May 7 that it was material. The application, the person involved and the number of customers were not disclosed.
